  "failure_mode": "Authors fail to disclose data licensing terms or ignore privacy/ethical risks associated with manipulating real human biometric data, leading to potential compliance violations or ethical concerns.",
  "why_it_matters": "Using real human data without proper licensing or privacy consideration can violate legal regulations (like GDPR) and ethical guidelines, posing risks of misuse, harassment, or disinformation.",
  "reviewer_dimension": "POL"
}
